name: Cinder Nip
desc: A small bite with a hot edge. Small, but it remembers.

name: Cinder Breath
desc: Breathes embers in the foe's face. Rude, and sometimes it catches.

name: Fizz Pop
desc: A burst of fizzy water. Mostly noise, a little sting.

name: Undertow
desc: Drags the foe under for a moment. It may come up soaked.

name: Lichen Lash
desc: A whip of crusted lichen. Slow to grow, quick to sting.

name: Puffcap Haze
desc: A cloud of spores that roots the foe where it stands.

name: Crackle Bite
desc: A bite that snaps with static. Rarely leaves a Jolt.

name: Pebble Toss
desc: A pebble, aimed well. The oldest argument there is.

name: Breeze Slice
desc: A thin cut of wind that always goes first.

name: Glint
desc: A flash in the eyes. The foe may be left Dazed.

name: Hush
desc: A whisper so soft the foe nods off.

name: Bowl Over
desc: Runs straight into the foe. Cheap and honest.

name: Kiln Strike
desc: A blow with the heat of a working kiln.

name: Furnace Spiral
desc: A spiral of furnace fire. Often leaves a Scorch.

name: Heat Haze
desc: Makes the air shimmer until the foe is Dazed.

name: Spindrift Shot
desc: A hard shot of sea spray.

name: Breaker Plunge
desc: Crashes in like a breaker. The user feels it too.

name: Drench
desc: Soaks the foe to the bone.

name: Thorn Volley
desc: A volley of thorns at every foe at once.

name: Sap Draw
desc: Draws the foe's strength like sap and heals by half.

name: Bloom Burst
desc: Everything blooms at once, violently.

name: Arc Bolt
desc: An arc of lightning. It often leaves a Jolt.

name: Storm Gnash
desc: Bites down with storm-charged teeth.

name: Charged Mist
desc: A mist that Jolts every foe it touches.

name: Siphon Spark
desc: A small spark that steals 1 Energy.

name: Tremor Thud
desc: Stamps the ground and shakes every foe.

name: Cairn Crash
desc: Brings down a whole cairn. Some of it lands on the user.

name: Updraft
desc: A lift of air that knocks the foe off its feet.

name: Gale Scythe
desc: A scythe of wind, swung low.

name: Squall
desc: A squall over every foe. It may leave them Dazed.

name: Prism Ray
desc: Light split into a cutting ray.

name: Dawn Mend
desc: First light closes half the user's wounds.

name: Radiant Lance
desc: A lance of hard light, driven in.

name: Dusk Rake
desc: A rake of claws at dusk. It may sap the foe's Might.

name: Gloom Ripple
desc: A ripple of gloom over every foe. It may Daze.

name: Dusk Gnaw
desc: Gnaws in the dark where no one can see.

name: Night Siphon
desc: Drinks the foe's strength by night and heals by half.

name: Wick Flicker
desc: A flicker from a short wick. Better than the dark.

name: Candle Ward
desc: A small candle heals the user a little. Mind the wax.

name: Mirk Nip
desc: A nip from out of the murk.

name: Murk Veil
desc: A veil of murk that leaves the foe Dazed.

name: Tunnel Strike
desc: Strikes up from below. May raise the user's Guard.

name: Salt Snap
desc: A snap of briny jaws. May leave a Soak.

name: Kelp Lash
desc: A lash of wet kelp. May Root the foe.

name: Kindle Up
desc: Stokes its own fire: Might up, more at full Vigor.

name: Hunker Down
desc: Hunkers down: Guard up, more at full Vigor.

name: Drift Step
desc: Drifts on the wind: Pace up, more at full Vigor.

name: Still Thought
desc: Goes quiet inside: Focus up, more at full Vigor.

name: Cower Shade
desc: Hides in its own shadow. The foe's Might drops.

name: Chill Mist
desc: A cold mist that slows every foe.

name: Overcharge
desc: Spends every spare Energy. More power for each point.

name: All-In Crash
desc: Throws in all it has. Every spare Energy adds power.

name: Ash Call
desc: Calls down an ash storm over the field.

name: Tide Call
desc: Calls the high tide over the field.

name: Murk Call
desc: Calls a deep murk over the field.

name: Spark Call
desc: Calls a static veil over the field.

name: Bloom Call
desc: Calls a pollen drift over the field.

name: Dawn Call
desc: Calls the dawn glow over the field.

name: Rubble Call
desc: Calls a rain of rubble over the field.

name: Gale Call
desc: Calls the eye of a gale over the field.

name: Glow Knuckle
desc: A glowing punch. May raise the user's Might.

name: Char Mark
desc: Brands the foe. Hits much harder if it already burns.

name: Spout Jab
desc: A jab of water. Hits harder on a Soaked foe.

name: Deepwell Draught
desc: A drink from a deep well: heals and washes off its status.

name: Pollen Prick
desc: A prick of pollen. Hits harder on a Rooted foe.

name: Static Tag
desc: Tags the foe with static. Hits harder on a Jolted foe.

name: Grid Lock
desc: Locks the foe's moves up: they cost more for 2 turns.

name: Grit Jab
desc: A gritty jab. Hits harder on a foe with any status.

name: Quarry Wall
desc: Raises a wall of quarry stone: Guard up by 2.

name: Landslip
desc: A landslip over every foe. May slow them.

name: Shard Bed
desc: Scatters shards on the foe's side. Newcomers bleed.

name: Monolith Drop
desc: Drops a monolith. Needs a turn to lift the next one.

name: Pumice Pelt
desc: Pelts with pumice. Often raises the user's Guard.

name: Fault Line
desc: Splits the ground along a fault. Ignores raised defences.

name: Crosswind
desc: A crosswind that takes the field's element.

name: Kite Cut
desc: A cut like a kite string. May raise the user's Pace.

name: Scatter Gale
desc: Blows snares off its side and slows the foe.

name: Downburst
desc: A crushing downburst. Needs a turn to gather again.

name: Draft Needle
desc: A needle of draught that always goes first.

name: Squall Line
desc: A line of squalls that slows the foe.

name: Cloudbreak
desc: Breaks the clouds open. The user is slower after.

name: Beacon Ping
desc: A beacon pulse. Hits harder on a Dazed foe.

name: Dawn Needle
desc: A needle of first light. Goes first and ignores its own Daze.

name: Shade Pounce
desc: Pounces from shadow. Hits harder on a weakened foe.

name: Gloom Handoff
desc: Hands its own status to the foe. Sharing is caring.

name: Capacitor Crash
desc: Dumps a capacitor at once. Needs a turn to recharge.

name: Pylon Snap
desc: A snap like a pylon line. May raise the user's Pace.

name: Short Circuit
desc: A violent short circuit. The user's Focus drops after.

name: Bellows Blast
desc: Works the bellows until the fire roars. Focus drops after.

name: Coal Seed
desc: Sows live coals on the foe's side. Newcomers burn.

name: Furnace Heart
desc: Opens its furnace heart. Needs a turn to cool.

name: Cinder Dash
desc: A dash trailing cinders. Always goes first.

name: Brazier Pulse
desc: A pulse of brazier heat over every foe. May Scorch.

name: Salt Spray
desc: Stinging salt spray. May slow the foe.

name: Rip Current
desc: A rip current that drags 1 Energy out of the foe.

name: Fathom Crush
desc: The weight of the deep at once. Needs a turn after.

name: Bore Wave
desc: A tidal bore over every foe. May Soak them.

name: Shoal Trap
desc: Hides shoals on the foe's side. Newcomers get Soaked.

name: Bramble Bed
desc: Plants brambles on the foe's side. Newcomers get Rooted.

name: Wildgrowth Crash
desc: A crash of wild growth. The user's Guard drops after.

name: Husk Shed
desc: Sheds its husk: cures its status and raises Pace.

name: Thornwake
desc: A wake of thorns over every foe. May Root them.

name: Bark Burst
desc: Bark bursts outward. May raise the user's Guard.

name: Seed Spit
desc: Spits a seed first thing. Manners are for later.

name: Graft
desc: Grafts a raised stage off the foe and onto itself.

name: Overdraw
desc: Burns 2 of the foe's Energy. Nobody gets it back.

name: Wire Trap
desc: Strings live wire on the foe's side. Newcomers get Jolted.

name: Lull Breaker
desc: Shouts the foe awake, and hits harder doing it.

name: Chaff Feint
desc: A feint in a cloud of chaff: foe's Might and Focus drop.

name: Gale Mantle
desc: Wraps itself in wind: Pace and Focus up.

name: Sunwell Sip
desc: A sip of sunlight: heals a little and raises Focus.

name: Daybreak Strike
desc: Strikes with all of the dawn. Needs a turn after.

name: Prism Burst
desc: A burst of split light. The user's Focus drops after.

name: Omen Bell
desc: Rings a bell. Two turns later, the omen lands.

name: Starlit Lash
desc: A lash of starlight. May sap the foe's Might.

name: Glow Trap
desc: Hides glowing lures on the foe's side. Newcomers get Dazed.

name: Night Toll
desc: Tolls for the foe. It can't heal for 3 turns.

name: Eclipse Crush
desc: Crushes like an eclipse. Needs a turn after.

name: Murmur Bite
desc: A bite with a murmur. Burns 1 of the foe's Energy.

name: Veil Step
desc: Steps out of a veil first. The foe never saw it.

name: Gloam Pact
desc: A pact with the gloam: Might up by 2, Guard down.

name: Dusk Snare
desc: Lays a snare on the foe's side. Newcomers lose Pace.

name: Gravel Hum
desc: A low hum of gravel. The foe's Pace drops by 2.

name: Slow Quake
desc: A slow, heavy quake. It always goes last.

name: Root Mend
desc: Puts down roots: heals now and for 3 turns.

name: Glowglass Slash
desc: A slash of rift glass. May Scorch.

name: Floodglass Wave
desc: A wave of rift glass. May Soak.

name: Vineglass Sting
desc: A sting of rift glass that heals a quarter of the damage.

name: Boltglass Bite
desc: A bite of rift glass. May slow the foe.

name: Rockglass Ram
desc: A ram of rift glass. May raise the user's Guard.

name: Stormglass Cut
desc: A cut of rift glass that always goes first.

name: Lightglass Beam
desc: A beam of rift glass that cures the user's status.

name: Duskglass Grip
desc: A grip of rift glass. May sap the foe's Focus.

name: Tailwind
desc: A wind at its back: Pace up by 2.

name: Root Grip
desc: Roots grip the foe. Often leaves it Rooted.

name: Night Veil
desc: Wraps itself in night: Guard and Focus up.

name: Quill Flick
desc: Flicks a quill. Ink gets everywhere.

name: Blot Wave
desc: A wave of ink blots. The foe may be left Dazed.

name: Margin Lash
desc: A lash from the margin, where the notes go.

name: Bell Tap
desc: Taps a bell. Somewhere, someone listens.

name: Resound
desc: A sound that comes back louder.

name: Toll of Ages
desc: Every bell that ever rang, at once.

name: Flake Rasp
desc: Rasps with a flaking edge. Tetanus not included.

name: Oxide Haze
desc: A haze of red dust. The foe may be left Dazed.

name: Seized Gear
desc: A gear that seized years ago, swung hard.

name: Veil Tap
desc: A light touch from behind a veil.

name: False Face
desc: Shows a friendly face, then strikes. May Daze.

name: Masquerade
desc: A dance of masks. Nobody knows who hit whom.

name: Etch Spit
desc: Spits something that etches. Do not ask what.

name: Bite Bath
desc: A bite steeped in pickling vat.

name: Sour Spray
desc: A spray so sour the eyes water.

name: Mordant Fang
desc: A fang wet with mordant.

name: Vat Surge
desc: The whole vat surges at the foe.

name: Corrode Claw
desc: A claw that eats through plate.

name: Vitriol Flood
desc: A flood of vitriol. May leave the foe Dazed.

name: Plate Biter
desc: Bites through armour plate and spits it out.

name: Acid Deluge
desc: A deluge of acid. Needs a turn after.

name: Fume Veil
desc: Fumes that eat at the foe's Guard.

name: Pickle Hide
desc: Pickles its own hide: Guard and Focus up.

name: Rime Nip
desc: A nip with frosted teeth.

name: Chill Puff
desc: A puff of cold breath.

name: Sleet Dart
desc: A dart of sleet.

name: Hoar Breath
desc: Breath that leaves frost on everything.

name: Icicle Rake
desc: Rakes the foe with icicles.

name: Glaze Wave
desc: A wave that glazes everything in ice.

name: Rime Shard
desc: A shard of old rime, sharp as spite.

name: Moor Blizzard
desc: A blizzard over the moor and every foe. May Daze.

name: Deep Freeze
desc: Freezes the foe through. Needs a turn after.

name: Frost Coat
desc: A coat of frost: Guard up by 2.

name: Numbing Mist
desc: A numbing mist that slows the foe.

name: Coin Toss
desc: Throws a coin. Heads it hurts, tails it hurts.

name: Leaf of Gold
desc: A leaf of gold, thin and sharp.

name: Gilded Jab
desc: A jab with a gilded knuckle.

name: Shine Burst
desc: A burst of polished shine.

name: Bullion Bash
desc: Hits with a bar of bullion. Money talks.

name: Gold Glare
desc: A glare of gold that hurts to look at.

name: Hoard Crush
desc: Drops a whole hoard on the foe.

name: Treasure Flare
desc: A flare off a buried treasure. May Daze.

name: Golden Span
desc: A span of gold, swung like a bridge. Needs a turn after.

name: Gild Armour
desc: Gilds its armour: Guard and Might up.

name: Dazzle Coin
desc: Flips a dazzling coin: foe's Might and Focus drop.

name: Noon Peck
desc: A peck at the hottest hour.

name: High Glint
desc: A glint from high above.

name: Skyward Kick
desc: A kick that starts at the sky.

name: Apex Ray
desc: A ray from the top of the sky.

name: Overhead Strike
desc: Strikes straight down from overhead.

name: Sunpeak Beam
desc: The beam of the sun at its peak.

name: Summit Drop
desc: Drops from the summit, all of it.

name: Meridian Blaze
desc: A blaze along the meridian over every foe. May Daze.

name: Height of Noon
desc: The full weight of noon. Needs a turn after.

name: Rise Above
desc: Rises above it all: Pace up, more at full Vigor.

name: Clear Sky
desc: A clear sky clears the mind: Focus up by 2.

name: Tinder Flick
desc: Flicks a bit of tinder at the foe. It was going to burn anyway.

name: Soot Smudge
desc: Smears soot in the foe's eyes. Worse if it can't see straight already.

name: Pyre Waltz
desc: A slow dance around a fire someone else built. May raise Focus.

name: Hearth Collapse
desc: The whole hearth comes down, chimney and all. Often leaves a Scorch.

name: Ember Lash
desc: A lash of glowing rope. Rarely leaves a Scorch.

name: Bonfire Body
desc: Throws its burning body at the foe. Everyone gets warm.

name: Smoulder
desc: Lets the foe catch, slowly. It won't notice until it's too late.

name: Banked Coals
desc: Banks its coals for later: gains 3 Energy.

name: Charcoal Grin
desc: Grins with blackened teeth: Might and Focus up.

name: Kiln Rush
desc: Rushes in with the heat of a kiln door opening.

name: Last Ember
desc: Burns the last of its ember in one go. Focus drops hard after.

name: Pitch Torch
desc: A torch dipped in pitch. It does not go out politely.

name: Puddle Jump
desc: Jumps in a puddle right next to the foe. Worse if it's wet already.

name: Brine Pellet
desc: A pellet of hard brine, flicked.

name: Riptide Coil
desc: Coils water around the foe and takes back a quarter.

name: Drowned Bell
desc: A bell rings from under the water. Nobody likes that. May lower Focus.

name: Wave Shoulder
desc: Shoulders into the foe like a wave on a pier.

name: Wreck Diver
desc: Dives at the foe from a wreck it calls home. May Soak.

name: Fog Bank
desc: Rolls in like coastal fog: Guard and Pace up.

name: Low Water
desc: The tide goes out on the foe: burns 2 of its Energy.

name: Rainwash
desc: A cold rain washes the whole team clean of status.

name: Harbour Swell
desc: A swell that lifts every boat in the harbour, and the foe.

name: Abyss Hymn
desc: The deep sings to every foe. Nobody asked it to. May Soak.

name: Thistle Puff
desc: Blows thistle fluff at the foe. It itches for days.

name: Spore Dart
desc: A dart of spores. Worse on a Rooted foe.

name: Canopy Crash
desc: The whole canopy falls on the foe. May slow it.

name: Nettle Rub
desc: Rubs nettles in where it hurts. Rarely Roots.

name: Overgrowth
desc: Grows over itself: Guard and Focus up.

name: Compost Pact
desc: Feeds a quarter of its Vigor to the soil: Might up by 2.

name: Pollen Choir
desc: A choir of pollen. Everyone sneezes, everyone is cured.

name: Old Oak
desc: Swings like an old oak that has stopped caring.

name: Verdant End
desc: Everything is green in the end. Takes back a quarter.

name: Spark Prod
desc: Prods the foe with a spark. Worse if it's Jolted already.

name: Live Wire
desc: A live wire, held by the wrong end. May Jolt.

name: Ball Lightning
desc: A ball of lightning that rolls straight at the foe.

name: Thunderhead
desc: A thunderhead over every foe. May Jolt.

name: Fuse Box
desc: Flips its own breakers: Focus and Pace up.

name: Dynamo Hum
desc: Hums like a dynamo: gains 3 Energy.

name: Brownout
desc: Drops the foe's power: Might and Pace down.

name: Pylon Fall
desc: Drops a whole pylon on the foe. Takes some recoil.

name: Crackle Jab
desc: A quick jab that crackles.

name: Arc Weld
desc: Welds a seam into the foe. May lower its Guard.

name: Grid Collapse
desc: Takes the whole grid down with it. Focus drops hard after.

name: Static Kiss
desc: A small kiss with a big spark. The foe is Jolted.

name: Grit Spray
desc: Sprays grit at the foe. Gets in the teeth.

name: Cave Echo
desc: A boom from a deep cave. May slow the foe.

name: Ore Pulse
desc: A pulse from the ore deep below.

name: Strata Burst
desc: Every layer of rock bursts at once. May raise Guard.

name: Dust Devil
desc: A spinning devil of dust over every foe.

name: Boulder Roll
desc: Rolls a boulder downhill. The foe is downhill.

name: Sediment
desc: Lets everything settle: all stages on both sides go back to 0.

name: Bedrock
desc: Plants itself like bedrock: Guard and Might up.

name: Mountain Fall
desc: A mountain falls once in an age. This is the age.

name: Quarry Hymn
desc: A work song from the quarry. The whole team shakes off its status.

name: Puff of Air
desc: A puff of air. Polite, until it isn't.

name: Whistle Wind
desc: A whistle that cuts through sleep. Worse on a Drowsy foe.

name: Gust Ladder
desc: Climbs a ladder of gusts and kicks down. May raise Pace.

name: Weathervane
desc: Spins like a weathervane and strikes whichever way it points.

name: Cyclone Wheel
desc: A wheel of wind that rolls over every foe.

name: Shear Wind
desc: A shear wind that cuts past raised defences.

name: Calm Eye
desc: Steps into the calm eye: all stages on both sides go back to 0.

name: Second Wind
desc: Catches its second wind: gains 3 Energy.

name: Jet Stream
desc: Rides the jet stream high and comes down hard. Pace drops after.

name: Pinwheel
desc: A small pinwheel spin that always goes first.

name: Lantern Swing
desc: Swings a lantern at the foe. The light was only the start.

name: Halo Kick
desc: A kick with a halo on top. May Daze.

name: Lamp Oil
desc: A splash of hot lamp oil. Careful with that.

name: Searchlight
desc: Finds the foe no matter what. Ignores its own Daze.

name: Vigil Light
desc: Keeps a vigil light burning: the whole team is cured.

name: Mirror Shine
desc: Shines a mirror in the foe's face: Might and Focus down.

name: Clear Glass
desc: Wipes the glass clean: all stages on both sides go back to 0.

name: Solar Choir
desc: A choir of suns over every foe. May Daze.

name: Gleam Edge
desc: An edge of pure gleam. May raise Might.

name: Shadow Whisper
desc: Whispers something awful. True, though.

name: Dread Note
desc: Leaves a note that says it knows. May lower Might.

name: Nightfall
desc: Night falls early, and only on the foe. Rarely leaves it Drowsy.

name: Void Pulse
desc: A pulse from where nothing is. Needs a turn after.

name: Backstab
desc: Strikes where the foe trusted it. Worse on a weakened foe.

name: Grave Dust
desc: Blows grave dust in the foe's face. It is Dazed, and offended.

name: Debt Collector
desc: Comes to collect. Takes 1 Energy as interest.

name: Pall
desc: Drops a pall over the foe.

name: Ink Spatter
desc: Spatters ink. Somebody will have to clean that.

name: Nib Prick
desc: Pricks with a nib before anyone sees it move.

name: Ledger Slap
desc: Slaps the foe with a heavy ledger. Every debt in it is real.

name: Smudge
desc: Smudges the foe's thoughts. May lower Focus.

name: Seal and Sign
desc: Stamps a seal on the foe. May lower Guard.

name: Inkwell Flood
desc: Tips the inkwell over the foe. May Daze.

name: Redaction
desc: Blacks out the foe's defences. Ignores raised stages.

name: Fine Print
desc: Hits with the fine print nobody read. May slow the foe.

name: Final Draft
desc: Writes the ending. Focus drops after.

name: Blotted Page
desc: Holds up a blotted page. The foe is Dazed trying to read it.

name: Rewrite
desc: Rewrites the page: all stages on both sides go back to 0.

name: Footnote
desc: Adds a footnote that the foe can't heal for 3 turns.

name: Quill Sharpen
desc: Sharpens its quill: Might up, more at full Vigor.

name: Margin Note
desc: Writes itself a margin note: Focus and Guard up.

name: Errata
desc: Corrects the foe. Worse if something is already wrong with it.

name: Ink Trap
desc: Leaves wet ink on the foe's side. Newcomers slip and get Dazed.

name: Spine Crack
desc: Cracks a book's spine. Or something's.

name: Palimpsest
desc: Scrapes the foe clean and writes over it. Heals a quarter.

name: Ink Rain
desc: It rains ink on every foe. Nobody has an umbrella for this.

name: Censor
desc: Censors the foe: its arts cost more for 2 turns.

name: Bloodied Quill
desc: A quill that has signed too much. Needs a turn after.

name: Hum Back
desc: Hums the foe's own noise back at it.

name: Clapper
desc: Hits like a bell clapper. Ding.

name: Knell
desc: A slow knell. May lower Might.

name: Rebound Peal
desc: A peal that bounces off the user and into the foe. May raise Guard.

name: Belfry Drop
desc: Drops from the belfry. The bell comes too.

name: Choir Loft
desc: The whole choir loft sings at every foe.

name: Hollow Tone
desc: A tone so hollow the foe's head rings. May Daze.

name: Great Bell
desc: Swings the great bell. It swings back.

name: Last Toll
desc: The last bell anyone will hear. Focus drops after.

name: Ringing Ears
desc: Leaves the foe's ears ringing. It is Dazed.

name: Lullaby Echo
desc: A lullaby that comes back from every wall. The foe dozes off.

name: Tuning Fork
desc: Strikes a tuning fork: Focus up, more at full Vigor.

name: Silence Please
desc: Asks for silence: all stages on both sides go back to 0.

name: Funeral March
desc: Marches slowly and surely: Guard and Might up.

name: Hymn of Rest
desc: A hymn for rest. The whole team is cured of status.

name: Reverb
desc: A sound that lands a turn late, but lands.

name: Feedback
desc: A shriek of feedback that burns 1 Energy.

name: Toll Debt
desc: Every toll is owed. Worse on a Dazed foe.

name: Bell Snare
desc: Hangs little bells on the foe's side. Newcomers get cut on them.

name: Echo Chamber
desc: Hears itself think: gains 3 Energy.

name: Thousand Bells
desc: A thousand bells at once. Needs a turn after.

name: Tetanus Nick
desc: A nick with a rusty edge. Worse on a foe already ailing.

name: Red Flake
desc: A flake of red rust, flicked.

name: Hinge Snap
desc: A hinge snaps shut on the foe. May slow it.

name: Corrosion Cloud
desc: A cloud that eats metal and patience. May lower Guard.

name: Anchor Chain
desc: Wraps the foe in an anchor chain. May Root it.

name: Scrap Storm
desc: A storm of scrap over every foe.

name: Wrecking Hulk
desc: Rams with a rusted hulk. Needs a turn after.

name: Rust Bloom
desc: Rust blooms on the foe: its Guard drops by 2.

name: Oil Can
desc: A drop of oil in the joints. Heals 40%.

name: Scrapyard
desc: Scatters scrap on the foe's side. Newcomers cut themselves.

name: Riveted
desc: Rivets itself shut: Guard up by 2.

name: Old Machine
desc: An old machine coughs into life: gains 3 Energy.

name: Iron Lung
desc: Breathes out a lungful of iron. Focus drops hard after.

name: Smile Wide
desc: Smiles too wide. The foe flinches.

name: Sleight
desc: A sleight of hand. It hit before you looked.

name: Two Faces
desc: Shows one face, strikes with the other. Worse on a weakened foe.

name: Charade
desc: A charade nobody understands. May Daze.

name: Jester Fall
desc: A jester's tumble that lands on the foe.

name: Grand Farce
desc: A farce staged for every foe. Nobody laughs.

name: Curtain Call
desc: Takes a bow, then the foe. Needs a turn after.

name: Borrowed Face
desc: Borrows the foe's best stage, and its face.

name: Crocodile Tears
desc: Weeps until the foe feels bad: Might down by 2.

name: Hidden Knife
desc: Hides a knife behind a smile: Might up by 2, Guard down.

name: Pass the Blame
desc: Hands its own status to the foe. It was never its fault.

name: Stage Fright
desc: Gives the foe stage fright. It is Dazed.

name: Unmasked
desc: Takes the mask off. Nobody wanted to see that. Guard drops after.

name: Fizzle Bite
desc: A bite that fizzes. Worse on a foe already ailing.

name: Lye Splash
desc: A splash of lye. May lower Guard.

name: Brine Pickle
desc: Pickles the foe a little. Then a lot.

name: Etched Fang
desc: A fang etched to a fine edge. May lower Guard.

name: Sulphur Sigh
desc: A sigh that smells of eggs and regret. May Daze.

name: Tannery Pit
desc: Opens a tannery pit under every foe.

name: Dissolve
desc: Dissolves every change: all stages on both sides go back to 0.

name: Acid Bath
desc: Runs the foe a bath: Guard and Focus down.

name: Vinegar Trap
desc: Spills vinegar on the foe's side. Newcomers lose Guard.

name: Ferment
desc: Lets itself ferment: heals now and for 3 turns.

name: Sour Turn
desc: Turns a quarter of its Vigor sour: Focus up by 2.

name: Etching
desc: Etches straight through raised defences.

name: Caustic Rain
desc: A caustic rain over every foe. May lower Guard.

name: Pickled Punch
desc: A punch that has been sitting in brine for years.

name: Frostbite
desc: A bite that leaves the toes numb. May slow the foe.

name: Snow Dust
desc: Throws a handful of snow dust. Cold, mostly.

name: Black Ice
desc: Black ice under the foe. Worse if it's wet.

name: Hailstone
desc: A hailstone the size of a fist. May Daze.

name: Avalanche Run
desc: Runs down with an avalanche behind it, onto every foe.

name: Whiteout
desc: Everything goes white. May slow the foe.

name: Cold Shoulder
desc: Gives the foe the cold shoulder: Might and Pace down.

name: Hibernate
desc: Sleeps off half its wounds. Don't wake it.

name: Ice Floor
desc: Freezes the foe's side. Newcomers slip and lose Pace.

name: Thaw Song
desc: Sings the thaw: the whole team shakes off its status.

name: Rime Armour
desc: Grows a rime armour: Guard and Focus up.

name: Glacier Calve
desc: A glacier calves onto the foe. Focus drops after.

name: Permafrost
desc: Ground that never thaws, swung at the foe. Pace drops hard after.

name: Icicle Lunge
desc: Lunges with an icicle like a short spear.

name: Gilt Flick
desc: Flicks a gold fleck. Worse on a Dazed foe.

name: Tithe
desc: Takes its tenth. Steals 1 Energy.

name: Gilt Edge
desc: An edge of gold leaf, sharper than it looks.

name: Golden Calf
desc: Charges like something people once prayed to. May raise Might.

name: Midas Pulse
desc: A pulse that turns the foe's legs heavy as gold. May slow it.

name: Vault Door
desc: Slams a vault door on the foe. May raise Guard.

name: Gold Rain
desc: It rains gold on every foe. It still hurts.

name: Bribe
desc: Slips the foe a coin: its Might and Pace drop.

name: Interest
desc: Lets its savings grow: gains 3 Energy.

name: Ransom
desc: Holds the foe to ransom: its arts cost more for 2 turns.

name: Gold Plating
desc: Plates itself in gold: Guard up by 2.

name: Coin Bed
desc: Scatters shiny coins on the foe's side. Newcomers stare and get Dazed.

name: Crown Fall
desc: A crown falls. So does whoever wore it. Guard drops after.

name: Gilded Cage
desc: A cage of gold. Pretty, and locked. May Root.

name: Noon Flash
desc: A flash at noon that strikes first.

name: Sky Hook
desc: A hook from straight above. May raise Pace.

name: Plumb Line
desc: Drops straight as a plumb line, past any defence.

name: Crest Dive
desc: Dives from the crest of the sky.

name: Zenith Beam
desc: A beam from the top of the sky. May raise Focus.

name: Corona
desc: A corona over every foe. May Daze.

name: High Noon Duel
desc: Waits for the stroke of noon, then draws.

name: Thin Air
desc: Takes the foe up where the air is thin: Focus and Pace down.

name: Sun Dial
desc: Waits a sundial's hour: heals 40%.

name: Clear Horizon
desc: Clears the horizon: all stages on both sides go back to 0.

name: Summit Air
desc: Breathes summit air: Pace and Might up.

name: Glare Field
desc: Leaves a glare on the foe's side. Newcomers lose Focus.

name: Apex Fall
desc: Falls from the very top. Needs a turn after.

name: Overhead Sun
desc: The sun right overhead, where it hurts most.

name: Tide of Dawn
desc: Velahra's own art: the tide comes in gold at dawn and takes a quarter back.

name: Hallow Peal
desc: Hallowmur's own art: a peal so holy the foe can't heal for 3 turns.

name: Last Word
desc: Scriptorax's own art: it always has the last word, past any defence.

name: Vane of Morning
desc: Lumivane's own art: a vane of light that turns to strike. May raise Pace.

name: Zephyr Verdict
desc: Zephyrel's own art: the west wind passes judgement on every foe.

name: Lurking Mass
desc: Monolurk's own art: a mass of stone that was always there. May raise Guard.

name: Lucent Void
desc: Vorlucent's own art: a void that glows, and eats 1 Energy.

name: Crownfire Rend
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crowntide Surge
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crownthorn Lash
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crownbolt Arc
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crownstone Break
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crowngale Rush
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crownlight Ray
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crownshade Grasp
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crownink Scrawl
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crownecho Peal
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crownacid Etch
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.

name: Crownfrost Shatter
desc: A master technique from the shop: power 115, no drawback.
